meta.name: Abyssal Hydro-Alchemist
meta.description: A rare subterranean guild artisan of The Alkahest Vitriol & Abyssal Hydro-Works. Found in the deepest strata, they treat the quarry as a vast terraced alembic, offering alchemical secrets to transmute pumice with caustic hydro-vitriol.
